name: No Man's Sky
description: Connector to No Man's Sky: inventories, equipment, galaxy and system maps, trade routes, settlements, frigates, timers, your discoveries, companions and creature-battle abilities, and a persona that answers from your game data. Keeps a Codex knowledge library up to date.
